findings.body: The previous P2 remains open. Both views read events.jsonl without the writer guard at src/forge/board.py:203–204. On Windows, an overlapping read can make this replacement raise PermissionError, failing a worker, reader, reviewer or test command while it records progress. Add bounded replacement retries, as src/forge/codex.py:532–539 already does for its records.
findings.title: Handle Windows readers holding the progress file open

findings.body: The previous P2 remains open. This decoder places error_during_execution before the missing-session diagnostic and returns it through stdout. The worker's prefix check at src/forge/worker.py:441–443 consequently misses it, while the reader checks stderr at src/forge/story.py:732. Both refuse instead of restarting with the full prompt. Recognize the structured diagnostic in both callers while preserving other failures. The response shape is documented in the [upstream reproduction](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/40609).
findings.title: Preserve missing-session recovery for structured Claude errors
